source.format: 64x64 CI8 in MIO0, RGBA16 palette of 0xC0 kart + 0x40 wheel colours

content_note: content_rows span the drive and ring poses; each pose lists its own, and the tumble frames can fill the whole square

angle.zero: camera straight behind the kart; 180 is head on
angle.measure: bearing from camera to kart minus the kart's heading, positive with the camera on the kart's left side (nose points to the right of the frame)
angle.coverage: frames cover 0-180; for 180-360 use the frame for 360 - angle mirrored horizontally (UNK_002_UNKNOWN_0x4, func_8002934C line 771)
angle.rule: a in 65536ths of a turn, folded to 0..0x7FF9 by a = -a when a >= 0x7FF9; drive: a // 0x208 while a // 128 < 0x51, else 15 + a // 1638, max 34; ring (spin out): a // 1638, 20 and over wraps to 0

tumble.note: played by the crash animation counter (unk_0A8 >> 8), not by camera angle
